prompt: Fit a Gamma distribution to 500 observed claim sizes and report the probability of a loss above a specified threshold.
required_behaviour: Correct Gamma shape and scale parameterisation
Tail probability is between zero and one
failure_modes: Using SciPy parameter names without checking PAL
Treating plug-in predictions as parameter-uncertainty adjusted

prompt: You have a large-loss listing where claims below £75,000 are unreported and amounts at a £300,000 policy limit are capped. Fit an underlying severity model.
required_behaviour: Uses reporting threshold as left truncation
Uses limit-hit records as right censoring
failure_modes: Treating capped payments as exact ultimate losses
Extrapolating below reporting threshold without additional information

prompt: Generate annual aggregate loss and maximum single loss from Poisson claim counts and LogNormal individual severities for 1,024 years.
required_behaviour: Claim counts and severities represented as frequency-severity model
Uses aggregate and occurrence semantics correctly
failure_modes: Mixing up claim index and simulation index

prompt: Price the expected annual recovery of a £2m excess of £1m occurrence reinsurance layer using simulated claims.
failure_modes: Applying occurrence limit to annual aggregate instead of individual claims
Calling expected recovery a quoted commercial premium

prompt: Simulate two correlated insurance lines with a Gaussian copula, and include expenses calculated from one line before the copula is applied.
required_behaviour: Coupling group carries expense-derived values through reordering
failure_modes: Reordering a raw array without its expense component
Incorrectly interpreting a copula as a linear correlation of arbitrary transformed values

prompt: Apply a stochastic annual inflation rate to the claims in a frequency-severity simulation, then calculate annual inflated losses.
required_behaviour: All claims in same simulation share inflation
failure_modes: Drawing inflation independently per claim
Using wrong broadcast dimension

prompt: Compare Monte Carlo with randomized quasi-Monte Carlo for a standard Normal distribution, and restore the usual sampling configuration afterwards.
required_behaviour: Uses reproducible seed and power-of-two sample size
failure_modes: Claiming within-scramble points are IID
Claiming RQMC always improves precision

prompt: Calculate the 99.5th percentile of aggregate annual loss from a frequency-severity model, distinguishing VaR from expected loss.
failure_modes: Using claim-level percentile as annual aggregate VaR
Using 0.995 when API expects 99.5

prompt: Fit a Generalised Pareto tail model to reported large losses with a policy limit, and estimate a high attachment loss probability.
failure_modes: Ignoring censored values
Inventing confidence guarantees from a fitted MLE

prompt: Model a three-layer excess-of-loss reinsurance programme, including annual aggregate recoveries and reinstatement premiums.
required_behaviour: Sets occurrence attachments and limits correctly
failure_modes: Treating reinstatements as free additional cover
Incorrectly mixing per-event and aggregate amounts

prompt: Derive a simulated gross, ceded and net loss from a frequency-severity model and an occurrence layer, then check the scenario-wise accounting identity.
required_behaviour: Preserves stochastic coupling across gross and ceded outputs
Net equals gross less ceded in each simulation
failure_modes: Pairing unrelated scenarios
Dropping coupling metadata through raw array reconstruction

prompt: Create a stochastic severity parameter driven by an economic factor, generate aggregate claims, and apply a copula to another risk factor.
required_behaviour: Copula reordering propagates to dependent quantities
failure_modes: Drawing stochastic parameters independently per claim
Breaking coupling in chained distribution calls
